The first downloadable build of galleryLAB: the foundation the gallery is built on. You can set up a
Library and create, rename and remove projects. Importing photos and generating galleries come in the
next releases.

## Download

- **galleryLAB-0.1.0-setup.exe** installs galleryLAB for your Windows account (no administrator rights
  needed) and adds Start menu and desktop shortcuts. You can choose the install folder.
- **galleryLAB-0.1.0-portable.exe** runs without installing. Keep it anywhere, for example on a USB drive.

Requires Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit.

This build isn't code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may say it “protected your PC”. Choose
**More info**, then **Run anyway**. To check your download, compare its SHA-256 with `SHA256SUMS.txt`
(in PowerShell: `Get-FileHash .\galleryLAB-0.1.0-setup.exe`).

## What's in 0.1

- **Your Library.** On first launch, choose where your Library lives (it suggests `Pictures\galleryLAB`).
  The Library is a plain folder of project folders, so you can back it up or move it like any other folder.
- **Projects.** Create a project with **New project** (or Ctrl+N) and type its name. Rename one with F2 or
  a double-click on its title, and the folder on disk is renamed too. Remove one with Delete or the
  right-click menu; it goes to the Recycle Bin, so you can restore it. Changes you make to the Library
  folder in Explorer show up in galleryLAB on their own.
- **Light and Darkroom themes.** galleryLAB follows your Windows theme. You can also pick a theme in
  **Settings**. Darkroom is a neutral gray with no tint, for judging photographs.
- **Keyboard.** Arrow keys move between projects, F2 renames, Delete removes, Escape cancels.

## Not in this release

Adding photos, reading them, and designing and walking the 3D gallery are still being built. Projects
you create now keep working in later versions.

## Known limitations

- The installer and exe aren't code-signed (see the SmartScreen note above).
- There are no automatic updates yet. To update, download the next release and install it over this one.
  Your Library and settings stay where they are.
